item.title: Sign stolen, thrown across room: Hostile crowd greets TPUSA at Wesleyan University
item.description: At Wesleyan University, a hostile crowd confronted the unofficial Turning Point USA chapter.

item.title: Another ‘Dead ICE Agents Can’t Kill’ flyer found at Penn State University
item.description: The graphic black and white flyer states 'Dead ICE Agents Can’t Kill' in capital letters above an image of an ICE agent hanging dead from a noose.

item.title: Winemaking scholar alleges Penn State faulted her for not being DEI enough: lawsuit
item.description: A Penn State University educator alleges she was denied two promotions due to insufficient adherence to the university's diversity, equity, and inclusion standards, according to a lawsuit.

item.title: ASU professor calls U.S. history a ‘400-year’ pattern of ‘reproductive oppression’
item.description: Fight over 'bodily autonomy' about who is seen as 'human enough,' professor said.

item.title: Columbia anti-Israel group posts ‘Death to America’ in Persian, prompting backlash
item.description: Columbia said the group is not a recognized campus student organization.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks California policy hiding student gender transitions from parents
item.description: 'Watershed moment for parental rights in America.'

item.title: Professor fired for officiating same-sex wedding heads to MI Supreme Court
item.description: The Michigan Supreme Court will soon hear a discrimination lawsuit filed by former Calvin University professor Joe Kuilema, who was fired after officiating a same-sex wedding. Kuilema alleges the firing constituted unlawful associational and retaliatory discrimination under Michigan’s Elliott-Larsen Civil Rights Act. item.title: Biologist accuses Cornell of ‘egregious’ discrimination against white men in lawsuit
item.description: Evolutionary biologist Colin Wright has sued Cornell University for allegedly excluding white candidates in hiring processes based on race. The lawsuit cites internal emails and other documents that Wright's attorney says show the 'exclusion of huge swaths of candidates based on race and ethnicity.'

item.title: ‘Toxic indoctrination’: Dept. of War cuts fellowships at 13 ‘elite’ universities
item.description: Universities have 'poisoned' U.S. military education system, Hegseth said.
